bargain_before_help_at_dusk.before_text: The village needs the crossing tonight? Clear this basket so I can reach my tools.

first_lie_at_dusk.speaker: Keeper
first_lie_at_dusk.before_text: I was at this morning's council meeting. No repair order. Ask me yourself.
first_lie_at_dusk.after_text: There was no council order. Take the rune home. I won't start a repair in the dark.

apology_at_dusk.speaker: Keeper
apology_at_dusk.before_text: All right. You've withdrawn the order. Tell me what you actually need.
apology_at_dusk.after_text: You've withdrawn the order. It's too dark to start the repair tonight.
